offlineVoiceAndroidStep1: Connect the tablet to Wi-Fi. The voice has some tens of MB.
offlineVoiceAndroidStep2: Open the Android settings and search for "text-to-speech". It's usually under System → Languages, or Accessibility.
offlineVoiceAndroidStep3: As "Preferred engine", choose "Speech Services by Google". If it's missing, install it for free from the Play Store.
offlineVoiceAndroidStep4: Tap the gear next to the engine → "Install voice data" → "Portuguese (Brazil)" and tap download. Wait until it's finished.
offlineVoiceAndroidStep6: Close the app completely and open it again. Here, press "Search voices again" and then "Listen to a sample".
offlineVoiceAndroidStep7: To check without internet: turn on airplane mode and press "Listen to a sample". If it speaks, "It worked without internet" is shown.

offlineVoiceIosHint: On iPhone and iPad: Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices → Portuguese (Brazil). Download a voice, then press "Search voices again".
offlineVoiceWindowsHint: On Windows: Settings → Time & language → Speech → Add voices → Portuguese (Brazil). Then close and open the browser again.

sobreLema: Free alternative communication for Brazilian families.
sobreOQueTexto: Grilo Falante is an alternative communication app. The child taps pictures and photos, builds a sentence and the app speaks for them, in Brazilian Portuguese. It works on phones, tablets and computers, also without internet.
sobreParaQuemTexto: For children who don't speak yet or speak little, like many children with autism or other disabilities, and for the families, schools and therapists around them. It is made for people with a simple device and little time.
sobrePorQueTexto1: Grilo Falante was born at home: a father wanted to give a voice to his non-verbal son. The apps out there were expensive, in English or needed internet all the time.
sobrePorQueTexto2: So he built an app the way the family needed it, and decided to make it free for any Brazilian family.
sobreDifSemInternetTexto: Pictures and voice are kept on the device.
sobreDifFotosTexto: Take a photo of the cup at home and record your voice on the button.
sobreDifModoCriancaTexto: The board fills the screen and only the adult opens the menus.
sobreDifPortuguesTexto: Words, screens and voice made for Brazil.
sobreDifAparelhoTexto: Runs on a cheap phone and needs no app store.
sobreDifGratisTexto: No ads and no subscription. The code is open.
sobreCodigoTexto: Grilo Falante is free software, licensed under AGPL-3.0. Anyone can use, study and improve it. Whoever distributes a modified version must publish its code too.
sobreCreditoAsterics: Based on {projeto}, by FH Technikum Wien (Austria), licensed under AGPL-3.0.
sobreCreditoArasaac: The pictograms are property of the Government of Aragón and were created by Sergio Palao for {arasaac}, which distributes them under the Creative Commons {licenca} license.
sobreCreditoFontes: Fonts: Atkinson Hyperlegible (Braille Institute) and Baloo 2 (Ek Type), SIL Open Font License; other optional fonts under free licenses.
sobreCreditoYoutube: Video buttons use YouTube services: see the {termos} and the {privacidade}.
sobreCreditoBibliotecas: Other libraries (Vue.js, PouchDB and more) under free licenses: {lista}.
ajudaIntro: Choose what you want to learn. Each guide has just a few steps.
ajudaPrimeirosPassosResumo: Create the child's profile and get the first board ready in a few minutes.
ajudaPrimeirosPassosPasso1: On the "Who is talking today?" screen, tap "New child".
ajudaPrimeirosPassosPasso2: Answer the questions: name, photo, age, voice and button size.
ajudaPrimeirosPassosPasso3: Tap "Start". The board is ready, with everyday words.
ajudaPrimeirosPassosPasso4: On the Home screen, tap "Talk" to open the board. Try it together with the child.
ajudaPrimeirosPassosDica: Not sure about an answer? Tap "Skip". You can change everything later.
ajudaMontarFraseResumo: The child taps the buttons, the sentence shows at the top and the app speaks.
ajudaMontarFrasePasso1: On the Home screen, tap "Talk" to open the board.
ajudaMontarFrasePasso2: Tap the buttons, one at a time. Each word goes into the strip at the top.
ajudaMontarFrasePasso3: Some pictures open a folder with more words, like eating or playing.
ajudaMontarFrasePasso4: Tap the coral "Talk" button. The app speaks the whole sentence.
ajudaMontarFrasePasso5: To repeat an earlier sentence, open "Sentences" and tap it.
ajudaMontarFraseDica: Tap the star on a sentence to save it to your favorites.
ajudaBotaoFotoResumo: Swap the picture for a real photo and record your own voice on the button.
ajudaBotaoFotoPasso1: Outside Child Mode, hold the button you want to change for 1 second.
ajudaBotaoFotoPasso2: Tap "Take photo". Take a photo now or choose one from the gallery.
ajudaBotaoFotoPasso3: Tap "Record voice". Say the word close to the device. You have up to 10 seconds.
ajudaBotaoFotoPasso4: Tap "Listen" to check. If you don't like it, record again.
ajudaBotaoFotoDica: Photos of things from the child's own home, like their cup, bed or grandma, help the child understand.
ajudaSemInternetResumo: Save the pictures and the voice on the device to use them anywhere.
ajudaSemInternetPasso1: Install the app on the device. See the "Install on phone or tablet" guide.
ajudaSemInternetPasso2: With Wi-Fi, on the Home screen, tap "No internet".
ajudaSemInternetPasso3: Tap the button to save the pictures on the device. Wait for the bar to finish.
ajudaSemInternetPasso4: In the "Voice without internet" part, tap "Listen to a sample". If it doesn't speak, follow the steps on screen to download a voice.
ajudaSemInternetPasso5: To check, turn on airplane mode, close the app, open it again and use the board.
ajudaSemInternetDica: Added new pictures to the board? Go back to "No internet" with Wi-Fi and save again.
ajudaModoCriancaTitulo: Child Mode and the Caregiver button
ajudaModoCriancaResumo: In Child Mode the board is locked and only the adult can open the menus.
ajudaModoCriancaPasso1: On the board, hold the "Caregiver" button until the panel slides up.
ajudaModoCriancaPasso2: Tap "Child Mode". The board locks: no menus, no scrolling and no zoom.
ajudaModoCriancaPasso3: Let the child use it freely. Swiping a finger or resting a hand does not press a button.
ajudaModoCriancaPasso4: To change something or leave, hold the "Caregiver" button again.
ajudaModoCriancaPasso5: In the panel, choose what you need: Edit board, Voice, Sentences, Home and more.
ajudaModoCriancaDica: Holding is on purpose: a quick tap from the child opens nothing.
ajudaArquivoCopiaTitulo: Save a copy and open from a file
ajudaArquivoCopiaResumo: Save everything to a file so you don't lose it and can move it to another device.
ajudaArquivoCopiaPasso1: To save: on the Home screen, tap "Boards" and choose the option to save a copy to a file.
ajudaArquivoCopiaPasso2: Keep the file (its name ends in .grd) somewhere safe, like Google Drive or your email.
ajudaArquivoCopiaPasso3: To open it on another device: on the "Who is talking today?" screen, tap "Open profile from a file".
ajudaArquivoCopiaPasso4: Choose the file and wait. The child's profile comes back with the boards, photos and recordings.
ajudaArquivoCopiaDica: Made a lot of changes? Save a new copy.
ajudaInstalarResumo: Put Grilo Falante on your device's home screen, like an app. It's free and needs no app store.
ajudaInstalarPasso1: On Android: open Grilo Falante in Chrome. Tap the ⋮ menu, then "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
ajudaInstalarPasso2: On iPhone or iPad: open it in Safari. Tap Share (the square with an arrow), then "Add to Home Screen".
ajudaInstalarPasso3: On a computer: open it in Chrome or Edge. Click the install icon at the end of the address bar.
ajudaInstalarPasso4: Done. Always open it from the new Grilo Falante icon.
ajudaInstalarDica: Install it while online and open it once before using it without Wi-Fi.
